schema_extension_requests.rationale: Halflingcycling is a typecycling variant (a discard-activated ability to search for a card of a named type). It is represented here with existing predicates (CONSUMES for the discard cost, MOVES_FROM/MOVES_TO library->hand). No existing predicate specifically records that this is a keyworded typecycling ability; flagging in case the graph wants to tag the keyword itself.
